# OzoneUI Full AI Reference & Copy-Paste Recipes (v1.0.0 — 66 Web Components)
# Canonical URL: https://ozoneui.nstudios.eu/
# Quick Reference: https://ozoneui.nstudios.eu/llms.txt

## 1. Zero-Build Single-File HTML Template (Run Immediately in Browser or AI Artifact)
```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-oz-mode="atmospheric" data-oz-theme="dark" data-oz-preset="emerald">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/valldy31/ozoneui@main/dist/ozone.css" />
  <script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/valldy31/ozoneui@main/dist/ozone.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <oz-app-shell heading="Dashboard" subtitle="Live telemetry">
    <oz-sidebar brand="Acme Cloud" icon="cpu" searchable active="Overview"
      items='[{"title":"Main","items":[{"label":"Overview","icon":"layout"},{"label":"Billing","icon":"sliders"}]}]'></oz-sidebar>
    <oz-grid cols="12" gap="24">
      <oz-col span="4" span-md="6" span-sm="12"><oz-stat title="MRR" value="$128,400" delta="+32%" trend="up" sparkline="40,55,48,72,95,128"></oz-stat></oz-col>
      <oz-col span="8" span-md="6" span-sm="12"><oz-chart type="area" title="Growth" labels="Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri" data="120,180,150,290,380" exportable></oz-chart></oz-col>
    </oz-grid>
  </oz-app-shell>
</body>
</html>
```

## 2. Mobile App / PWA Shell Recipe
```html
<oz-grid cols="12" gap="18">
  <oz-col span="12"><oz-ai-chat heading="Assistant" model="Gemini 2.5 Pro"></oz-ai-chat></oz-col>
</oz-grid>
<oz-fab position="bottom-right" icon="plus" items='[{"id":"new","label":"New Item","icon":"plus"}]'></oz-fab>
<oz-bottom-nav position="fixed" variant="floating" active="home"></oz-bottom-nav>
```

## 3. Forms, Calendars & Native FormData + AI Form Automation
All OzoneUI inputs accept `name`, `label`, `hint`, `error`, `disabled`, emit `oz-change`, and sync hidden `<input name="...">` automatically for standard `<form>` / PHP POST submissions:
```html
<form id="signup">
  <oz-input name="email" label="Work Email" icon="user"></oz-input>
  <oz-select name="role" label="Role" options="Owner,Admin,Editor"></oz-select>
  <oz-date-picker name="start" label="Start Date"></oz-date-picker>
  <oz-slider name="budget" label="Budget" range min="0" max="5000" min-value="800" max-value="3600" prefix="$" ticks></oz-slider>
  <oz-file-upload label="Brand Logo" accept="PNG, JPG, SVG" max-size="5"></oz-file-upload>
  <oz-combobox name="skills" label="Skills" multiple creatable options="HTML,CSS,TypeScript,AI"></oz-combobox>
  <oz-otp-input name="code" label="2FA Passkey" length="6"></oz-otp-input>
</form>
<script type="module">
  // Read & populate forms in 1 call:
  const data = Ozone.getFormData('#signup');
  Ozone.fillForm({ role: 'Admin', code: '482910' }, '#signup');
</script>
```

## 4. Multilingual (`Ozone.i18n`), PHP SSR Navigation & Print Utilities
- **i18n Dictionary**: Call `Ozone.i18n.setLocale('bg')` (built-in English & Bulgarian presets) or `Ozone.i18n.extend({ add: 'Order', inspect: 'Details', save: 'Save' })` to localize all product cards, social posts, composers, sidebars, and calendars automatically.
- **PHP / SSR Native Controls**:
  - `<oz-button variant="primary" type="submit" name="interaction_type" value="favorite">Favorite</oz-button>` submits its parent `<form>` natively (`FormData` + `SubmitEvent.submitter`).
  - `<oz-sidebar>` and `<oz-bottom-nav>` items with `"href": "?view=feed"` render real `<a href="...">` links supporting right-click/Ctrl-click open-in-new-tab and cancelable `oz-navigate`.
  - `<oz-product-card>` supports `aspect="16/9"`, `no-tilt`, `unit`, `stock-percent`, `stock-label`, `cta-label`/`cta-href`, `secondary-label`/`secondary-href`, `sold-out`/`sold-out-label`.
  - `<oz-post>` supports 16:9 HD `image="..."`, custom `badge="..."` + `badge-variant`, `avatar="..."`, and initial `liked`/`bookmarked`.
- **Layout & Print Utilities**: `.oz-aspect-16-9`, `.oz-h-scroll` (touch horizontal scroll strip without visible scrollbar), and `.oz-no-print` / `.oz-print-only` (`@media print` automatically hides floating overlays & topbars).

## 5. EU GDPR, Privacy, Accessibility & Security
- Zero remote font fetches (system/geometric stack only — avoids Google Fonts GDPR IP leak).
- Strict offline mode: `<html data-oz-gdpr="strict">` blocks optional remote Iconify icon CDN fetches.
- Planet49 GDPR banner: `<oz-cookie-consent policy-url="legal.html"></oz-cookie-consent>` with `Ozone.gdpr.{getConsent,setConsent,clearStorage,exportData}()`.
- Global Privacy Veil: `<html data-oz-privacy="true">` blurs sensitive `[mask="blur"]` and `mask-cols="email,mrr"` fields.
- XSS-safe `<oz-renderer>`: blocks unknown HTML tags, strips `on*` attributes, rejects `javascript:` / `vbscript:` / `data:text/html` URIs.
